description: Zoho CRM is a cloud‑based customer relationship management platform that lets businesses manage contacts, sales, and service data while enabling CRUD operations and integration with third‑party applications through flexible APIs and SDKs.

access.credential_access: client ID and client secret from developer console

mcp.details: Zoho CRM provides pre‑built MCP servers that translate natural‑language prompts from an AI agent into CRM actions by registering the server’s capabilities as tools the agent can call.

evidence.claim: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
Authorization code flow is used to obtain access and refresh tokens.
Access Token is a token that is sent to the resource server to access the protected resources of the user.
Authentication server provides Access and Refresh tokens to the client.
Server-based apps can use the authorization code flow to generate an access token.
Access token is an OAuth token used to access Zoho's protected resources.
Zoho CRM offers RESTful Core APIs
Zoho CRM provides GraphQL APIs as described in the GraphQL overview
Zoho CRM has a documented public API
Developer Edition is free and provides a developer account
Register app in Zoho Developer Console to get client ID and client secret
Get started by clicking GET STARTED in Zoho Developer Console
Zoho CRM MCP servers connect AI tools to Zoho CRM using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and expose CRM capabilities as tools.
Four composable MCP servers are offered, each scoped to specific CRM functions, allowing secure, authenticated AI agent access to read or modify CRM data.
